title: Boron–halide interactions for crystallization regulation of a 1.68 eV wide-bandgap perovskite prepared via a two-step method

Shizi Luo, Daxiong Liu, Xiang Deng, Zhuoneng Bi, Shuguang Cao, Tongjun Zheng, Liyao Xiong, Hao Li, Ning Li, Lavrenty G. Gutsev, Nikita A. Emelianov, Victoria V. Ozerova, Nikita A. Slesarenko, Alexander F. Shestakov, Sergey M. Aldoshin, Gennady L. Gutsev, Pavel A. Troshin, Bochuan Yang, Zhibo Zhao, Xueqing Xu
Leveraging tris(pentafluorophenyl)borane (BCF) to regulate crystallization of perovskite by the boron–halogen and hydrogen bonding effects enabled a PCE of 23.49% and 31.12% at 1.68 eV for single-junction PSCs and perovskite/Si TSCs, respectively.
